warning: Model output. Not an appraisal. Not a forecast of any official agency. All inputs are either official statistics (cited) or explicit analyst assumptions listed below.

assumptions.hold_horizon_note: Lease expiry window 2030-2035 (principal-supplied); 9 years from 2026 approximates the midpoint (repeat this key as hold_horizon_years_note for the site).
assumptions.hold_horizon_years_note: Lease expiry window 2030-2035 (principal-supplied); 9 years from 2026 approximates the midpoint.
assumptions.cap_rate_current_note: S28: Net Lease Advisor page-stated trailing 12-month average cap rate for the Jack in the Box brand.
assumptions.cap_rate_band_note: F-05: the two Los Angeles data points in S30 and S31. Deliberately NOT averaged (different structures).
assumptions.cap_rate_drift_base_note: Assumption: 5 bp/yr of continued mild repricing, consistent with the Baa yield moving 5.88%->6.59% during 2026 (S10). Not an official forecast.
assumptions.rent_growth_base_note: Assumption anchored to CPI-U food away from home (S08: +3.5% over the 12 months to 2026-09) rounded down.
assumptions.lease_term_decay_note: Assumption: each year of lost WALT costs ~1.25% of value while the lease has fewer than 10 years left. A convention, not a measured constant.
assumptions.renewal_cap_rate_benefit_note: Assumption: a 10-year extension re-rates the asset by ~75 bp versus a sub-5-year term.
assumptions.transfer_tax_tier1_note: S23: 4.45% combined city base + Measure ULA, tier 1.

illustrative.note: Actual dollars cannot be computed because the rent is unverified (Flagged F-01/F-02).

how_to_read: value_relative_* is a multiple of today's market value, not dollars.
value_relative_renew > value_relative_hold at every year because the renewal both removes residual decay and re-rates the cap rate.
value_relative_stress_no_renewal shows what the same asset is worth if rates drift 20 bp/yr instead of 5 bp/yr while you wait.
None of these are guarantees; they are the arithmetic consequence of the assumptions printed above.
